documented_probe: C-bb7cec38 (fit a parametric bayesian network over the discovered structure): covered at hard difficulty; the verifier independently recomputes the discovery rule and exact OLS fit and enforces KS tolerance (<=0.04) plus cross-column dependence checks on the resampled data.
notes: Three chained stages: deterministic structure discovery (thresholded correlation over a declared topological order), exact multiple-OLS parametric fit of every conditional (intercept, per-parent partial slopes, population residual std), and seeded ancestral sampling. The verifier re-runs the solver on three hidden data sets with different variables/orders/thresholds, recomputes edges and the OLS fit from the data, runs per-column two-sample KS tests against the true generating process, checks that discovered-edge correlations survive in the synthetic data, and requires byte-identical reruns. Rubric weights dependent_stages (sampling depends on fit depends on discovery), reasoning_depth (partial slopes vs pairwise, ddof=0), hidden_case_generalization, and quantitative_correctness; totals bucket to hard.
